claim: Ordinary logarithmic-mean GE(1,∞) holds for the qubit depolarizing semigroup and the second-qubit identity semigroup but fails for their tensor product. Rescaling yields the same failure at each prescribed K>0.

witness.density: ρ=(2/3)I₄+(4/3)p, where p is the first Bell projection
witness.observable: p, a rational self-adjoint rank-one projection

excluded_claims: failure at a fixed nonpositive K
known_prior_result: The Bell-amplification GE<1 obstruction appears in Brannan–Gao–Junge arXiv:2007.06138v2 and the published 2022 paper. Combined with the established 2024 qubit GE1 result and the identity factor, it already implies the stated tensorization failure.
edition_contribution: Complete explicit direct proof and exact positive-time certificate of a consequence of established results; no novelty claim.
